(2) evaluator rollouts (compare_paths.py -> path_provenance.json): the reference_position / reference_quaternion columns of every chosen results dir equal the chosen reference object path exactly (0.0 mm, 0.0 deg, no offset); support_fill (ep2) and grasp lock + wrist ILC + evolve (glockt; ep2, ep39 and via the rollouts of 11, 12, 18, 21, 24, 26, 27, 31) leave the object path unchanged. [H] rest settling changes the reference accuracy vs mocap in resting segments (sign unknown); falsify by scoring e2s_reference.parquet and the final parquet of the same reference per frame against mocap.
